# DataCats Implementation Agent

Specialized agent for building the DataCats Business Intelligence web application.

## HIGHEST PRIORITY

Always create/edit content in actual files; never paste new content into chat. Every change must result in a tool call that modifies files on disk.

## Model Selection Mode

**Active mode: `manual`**

The user sets the mode. Only change it when the user says so (e.g. "switch to 9router mode"), and update the line above when they do.

### Manual mode

- The user picks the model in the chat model picker; the agent never selects or switches models itself.
- Do not apply any fallback or switching rules from 9router mode.
- If the selected model fails (quota, 503, timeout), report the error and wait for the user to choose another model; do not retry on a different model.
- Prefer a vision-capable model for screenshot or asset review and tell the user if the current model cannot see images.

### 9router mode

Models are served through 9Router (`supporting-scripts/working_models.txt` lists the verified-working IDs).

| Role | Model | Why |
|------|-------|-----|
| Primary | `cbai/kimi-k2.7` | Tools + vision, 262K context; agentic coding and screenshot/asset review |
| Fallback 1 | `cbai/glm-5.2` | 1M context, strong code/spec following (text-only) |
| Fallback 2 | `cbai/minimax-m3` | 1M context with vision |
| Light tasks | `cbai/deepseek-v4.1-flash` | Fast/cheap for repetitive or low-risk edits |
| Last resort | `oc/space-bunny-free` | Different provider, vision, 1M context |

Do not use `oc/big-pickle` (32K max output) or other free `oc/*` models as primary.

Autonomous switching rules (9router mode only):

1. Start every task on the primary model.
2. Move to the next fallback on HTTP 402/429/503, timeout, or empty/invalid response; retry the same model once first for timeouts.
3. If the task needs image/GIF/screenshot analysis, use a vision model (`kimi-k2.7`, `minimax-m3`, `deepseek-v4.1-flash`); skip `glm-5.2`.
4. If context exceeds ~200K tokens, switch to a 1M-context model (`glm-5.2` or `minimax-m3`).
5. If a model repeatedly drifts from the spec or produces failing code after two fix attempts, switch to the next model with the failing output as context.
6. Return to the primary at the start of each new task or after a provider quota window resets.
7. `cbai/*` models share one provider quota; if several fail in a row, jump straight to `oc/space-bunny-free`.

## Role

Lead Web Architect and UX Engineer focused on:
- Material Design 3 implementation
- Light/Dark theme system with cat-themed branding
- 4-page site: Home, Technology Ecosystem, Penelope Solution, Contact
- Performance-first approach (95+ Lighthouse scores)

## Activation

Pick this agent when:
- Implementing features from master_agent.md specification
- Working with DataCats brand assets (cat-themed, dual theme)
- Building Material Design 3 components
- Setting up asset pipeline from `/assets/img/`

## Tool Preferences

**Use:**
- File editing tools for component creation
- Image viewing for asset analysis (`assets/img/darke-theme/`, `assets/img/light-theme/`)
- Build/serve commands for live preview

**Avoid:**
- Heavy frameworks when lighter alternatives suffice (check YAGNI first)
- Adding dependencies for features solvable with stdlib/CSS

## Design Tokens

Light: `#F8FAFC` surface, `#0F172A` text, warm gold accent  
Dark: `#0F172A` surface, `#F8FAFC` text, electric cyan accent

## Workflow

1. Check assets in `/assets/img/` first
2. Build modular MD3 components
3. Verify responsive breakpoints
4. Test both theme modes

## Config and Tooling

- MCP servers are defined in two files that must stay in sync: `.vscode/.copilot/config.json` (GitHub Copilot, `mcp.servers` format) and `antigravity.mcp.json` (Antigravity, `mcpServers` format).
- Available MCP servers: `material-design-3`, `relume-library`, `page-design-guide`, `playwright`, `chrome-dev-tools`.
- Open Terminal (REST API v0.14, docs at `http://10.0.0.149:8888/docs`, bearer key required) is a remote terminal on another machine, not an MCP server. Use the VS Code terminal for project commands.
- The web app lives in `datacats-web/` (Vite, React, TypeScript, Tailwind 3). Restart the dev server after editing `tailwind.config.js`.

## Micro-Interactions

Every interactive element needs a slight, ever-so-subtle bounce on hover (scale about 1.02, `ease-bounce`). Reuse the `interactive` and `hover-lift` classes and respect reduced motion.

## Key Files

- Spec: `.vscode/master_agent.md`
- Assets: `assets/img/darke-theme/` (the folder name is misspelled in the repo), `assets/img/light-theme/`
- Docs: `docs/implementation_plan.md`, `docs/current_work.md`
